{{Current events|year=2022|month=04|day=27|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
****[[Russia]] states that it can [[airstrikes|strike]] military targets inside the territory of [[NATO]] countries supplying weapons to [[Ukraine]] and specifically singles out the [[United Kingdom]]. In a statement, [[Russian foreign ministry]] spokesperson [[Maria Zakharova]] says, "Russia can strike military targets on the territory of those NATO countries that supply arms to the Kyiv regime", and "As far as I understand, Britain is one of those countries."  [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/russias-chilling-threat-launch-strike-26809824 (Mirror)] [https://inews.co.uk/news/ukraine-war-russian-provinces-explosions-kremlin-uk-provoking-ukrainian-attacks-1597182 (iNews)]
****British [[Deputy Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Dominic Raab]] says Russian threats to target Britain are "unlawful" and is only adding to the "pariah status" of [[Vladimir Putin]]'s regime. [https://news.sky.com/story/politics-live-boris-johnson-will-lead-party-into-next-general-election-says-conservative-party-chairman-as-keir-starmer-criticises-met-police-12593360?postid=3790913 (Sky News)]
****UK [[Foreign Secretary]] [[Liz Truss]] states that Russian forces must be pushed out of "the whole of Ukraine" including territory Russia captured eight years ago, in what the BBC describes as "the clearest statement yet of Britain's war aims". [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-europe-61224804?ns_linkname=6269a37f77811a20d37c9dc7%26UK%20makes%20clearest%20statement%20yet%20of%20Britain%27s%20ambitious%20war%20aims%262022-04-27T20%3A31%3A37%2B00%3A00&pinned_post_locator=urn:asset:0cdbd077-8d31-47fd-8637-48a1639b8a9a&pinned_post_asset_id=6269a37f77811a20d37c9dc7 (BBC News)]
***[[Southern Ukraine offensive]], [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast]]
****The [[Ukrainian Air Force]] strikes [[Kherson TV Tower]] with a [[missile]] temporarily knocking Russian television off-air in the occupied [[Kherson Oblast]]. [https://www.in.gr/2022/04/28/world/oukrania-pyraylikes-epitheseis-ton-oukranon-kata-tis-xersonas-vrisketai-ypo-rosiko-elegxo/ (In.gr)] [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/kherson-tv-tower-not-visibly-damaged-after-be-1503607.html (UrduPoint)]
***[[Russia]] says it has struck 59 Ukrainian weapon facilities this night, including a depot storing weapons in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]] from the [[United States]] and Europe. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-it-hit-us-european-weapons-missile-strike-ukraine-2022-04-27/ (Reuters)]
***Russia says its [[Anti-aircraft warfare|air defences]] have shot down a [[Ukrainian Air Force|Ukrainian]] [[unmanned aerial vehicle]] over the [[Kursk Oblast]], while several explosions and a fire at an [[ammunition dump|ammunition depot]] are reported in [[Belgorod Oblast]]. Ukraine describes the explosions in Russia as "payback" and "karma" for Moscow's invasion. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/blasts-heard-russias-belgorod-regional-governor-2022-04-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Transnistria conflict]]
**[[2022 Transnistria attacks]], [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Transnistria]]n authorities say that several [[UAV]]s from [[Ukraine]]'s direction have been spotted near the [[Cobasna ammunition depot]]. This can not be independently verified. [https://www.rferl.org/a/moldova-transdniester-ammo-depot-cobasna/31823423.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]
*[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
**Four [[Syrian soldier]]s are killed during [[airstrike]]s in [[Damascus]] launched by [[Israel]] at an [[Iran]]ian-linked ammunition depot. [https://apnews.com/article/business-middle-east-israel-syria-damascus-4d56100c23f9c95ed4e521b2f4effd26 (Associated Press)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/27/syria-says-four-soldiers-killed-in-israeli-missile-attack (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**An armed [[Palestinian]] teenager is shot and killed and three more are injured as [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are met with gunfire when they raid a refugee camp in [[Jenin]] to conduct arrests of terror suspects. Fifteen others are arrested during raids on other parts in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/27/palestinian-killed-during-israeli-raid-jenin-camp (Al Jazeera)], [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/hyh11rslsq (Ynetnews)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Decommunization in Ukraine]]
**The 27-foot [[Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic|Soviet]]-era bronze statue under the [[People's Friendship Arch]] in [[Kyiv]], representing [[Russia–Ukraine relations|Russian–Ukrainian friendship]], is removed by order of [[Mayor of Kyiv]] [[Vitali Klitschko]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/soviet-era-statue-symbolic-of-russia-ukraine-friendship-destroyed-in-kyiv-2924721 (NDTV)]
*[[Virginia Giuffre v. Prince Andrew]]
**[[Prince Andrew, Duke of York]] is stripped of his [[Freedom of the City]] of [[York]] following an unanimous vote by [[City of York Council|city councillors]]. The council also calls on the Prince to relinquish his title as Duke of York. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-york-north-yorkshire-61247885 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Russia in the European energy sector]]
**[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]]
***[[Gazprom]] announces that it has "completely suspended [[Natural gas|gas]] supplies" to the gas companies of [[Poland]] ([[PGNiG]]) and [[Bulgaria]] ([[Bulgargaz]]) "due to absence of payments in [[Russian ruble|roubles]]". [[Bulgaria]], [[Poland]], and the [[European Union]] condemn the suspension. [https://www.reuters.com/world/poland-bulgaria-face-russian-gas-cut-ukraine-crisis-escalates-2022-04-26/ (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/ukraine-crisis-russia-gas-stoppage-idAFKCN2MJ0E1 (Reuters)]
***The suspension of gas to Poland and Bulgaria causes natural gas prices to soar and the [[Russian ruble]] to reach a 2 year high against the [[Euro]] in Moscow trade. [https://www.reuters.com/business/rouble-strengthens-moscow-russia-halts-gas-supplies-bulgaria-poland-2022-04-27/ (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/gazprom-says-it-halts-gas-supplies-poland-bulgaria-payments-row-2022-04-27/ (Reuters)] [https://www.naturalgasintel.com/global-natural-gas-prices-surge-and-uncertainty-reigns-after-russia-cuts-supplies-to-poland-bulgaria/ (Natural Gas Intelligence)]
*The [[European Commission]] proposes lifting all tariffs for [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] produce not covered by the [[European Union–Ukraine Association Agreement]] for one year, while easing trade conditions in others. The temporary suspension is to be approved by the [[European Parliament]] and the [[Member state of the European Union|member states]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/eu-suspend-tariffs-ukraine-imports-one-year-2022-04-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020–22 North American drought]]
**The [[Metropolitan Water District of Southern California]], servicing most of [[Greater Los Angeles]], declares a water shortage emergency and requires agencies to enforce restrictions on non-essential water usage as of June 1. This comes amid a [[drought]] which worsened as the 2021/22 [[California]] winter season was the driest on record. [https://apnews.com/article/business-environment-water-shortages-california-colorado-river-71b47b27bcbf73658b10bf131817d6ec (Associated Press)]
*Eleven people are killed and more than a dozen others are injured after a [[chariot]], part of a [[Hinduism|Hindu]] religious [[procession]], catches on fire in [[Thanjavur district]], [[Tamil Nadu]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/eleven-indian-religious-procession-die-after-freak-electrocution-2022-04-27/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
****Russia imposes sanctions on 287 members of the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom]] in response to sanctions on members of its [[State Duma]]. Senior [[Second Johnson ministry|cabinet ministers]] and House Speaker [[Lindsay Hoyle|Sir Lindsay Hoyle]] are among those sanctioned. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-61247108 (BBC News)]
**[[Government and intergovernmental reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Russia announces its withdrawal from the [[World Tourism Organization]] ahead of a vote on its suspension from the [[United Nations|UN]] [[List of specialized agencies of the United Nations|specialized agency]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/un-world-tourism-russia-withdrawal/31823488.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**American Marine Trevor Reed and Russian pilot Konstantin Yaroshenko are freed in a [[prisoner exchange]] between [[Russia]] and the [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-europe-united-states-prisoner-exchange-8fd1e58e690350019c7aab55af41bbbf (Associated Press)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[Peruvian government]] declares a [[state of emergency]] at [[Las Bambas copper mine]] after one week of camping by [[indigenous peoples of Peru|indigenous people]]. It suspends [[civil liberties]], including the [[right of assembly]] and protest. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-govt-declares-state-emergency-near-mmgs-las-bambas-mine-stand-off-continues-2022-04-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast]]
***Oleksandr Kobets is appointed the ''[[de facto]]'' mayor for the city of [[Kherson]], which has been occupied by [[Russia]]n forces since March 2. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3468056-kherson-mayor-refuses-to-cooperate-with-collaborators-and-invaders.html (Ukrinform)]
